T: Let's do the time warp. Then eat.
D: A stranded couple find shelter in a castle run by a mad scientist from Transsexual, Transylvania.
P: Serve the toast when Frank proposes one at dinner.
S: Thick white bread toasted, buttered and cut into fingers, with honey, jam and yeast spread to choose from.
Cocktail frankfurts simmered in a sticky glaze of tomato sauce, brown sugar and mustard, served on toothpicks.
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, chilli, fennel seeds and garlic for 10 minutes.
M: best not ask what's in it
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, onion, egg and Worcestershire, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour.
Chicken dry-brined overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes and pan gravy.
W: Frank brings his creation to life on its birthday
Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 25 minutes, cooled, split and layered with strawberry jam and whipped cream, covered in vanilla buttercream brushed with edible gold, candles in.
K: Cranberry juice, vodka and lime over ice, shaken, in a coupe.

s.how: Toast 8 thick slices of white bread until golden and butter while hot. Cut into fingers and pile on a plate with little pots of honey, strawberry jam and yeast spread. Throwing it at the screen is optional.

Simmer 500g cocktail frankfurts in 125ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp yellow mustard and 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes, stirring until sticky and glossy. Pile into a warm bowl with toothpicks for picking.

m.note: best not ask what's in it
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with 4 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for an hour.

w.note: Frank brings his creation to life on its birthday
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with strawberry jam and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar, brush with edible gold and add candles.

d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml cranberry juice, 30ml vodka and 10ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe. Makes four, so shake them two at a time.
